name: kaseya-vsa-mcp
description: MCP server for Kaseya VSA RMM - manage endpoints, patches, procedures, alarms, and tickets through AI assistants
long_description: Provides AI assistants with structured access to your Kaseya VSA RMM tenant. List managed endpoints, inspect software/hardware inventory, review and deploy patches, run agent procedures, triage alarms, browse Service Desk tickets, and explore organizations and machine groups via the Model Context Protocol.
